narration:1:1660007001:1.text: Your attempt to talk with the Graveborn leads nowhere, and in the end, you decide to return to the cabin...
narration:1:1660007001:1.male: Your attempt to talk with the Graveborn leads nowhere, and in the end, you decide to return to the cabin...
narration:1:1660007001:1.female: Your attempt to talk with the Graveborn leads nowhere, and in the end, you decide to return to the cabin...

say:3:1660007002:0.text: When Oxana sees you, there's no surprise on her face, as though she's been expecting this.
say:3:1660007002:0.source_cn: 奥克萨娜看到你们，却表现得并不意外，仿佛一切她都早有预料。
say:3:1660007002:0.male: When Oxana sees you, there's no surprise on her face, as though she's been expecting this.
say:3:1660007002:0.female: When Oxana sees you, there's no surprise on her face, as though she's been expecting this.

say:5:1660007003:1.text: The snow's still coming down... Looks like Kiran's dug in his heels again.
say:5:1660007003:1.source_cn: 雪还没有停，看来……基里尔又任性了啊。

say:6:1660007004:0.text: He knows you sent us, but he won't budge. He's dead set on making that flower bloom. Well... at least the Hypofiends are taken care of.
say:6:1660007004:0.source_cn: 即便知道是奥克萨娜的委托，他还是执意要让霜心花绽放。不...

say:7:1660007005:1.text: That fool... he's not being selfish. Just scared. I'm sorry you had to get mixed up in all this. Love between a Graveborn and a human... sounds like a twisted fairy tale, doesn't it?
say:7:1660007005:1.source_cn: 那个傻瓜……他只是太害怕了。真是对不住，让你们卷入了这...

say:8:1660007006:1.text: Come on in. There's soup on the fire. You kept your word and didn't lay a finger on him. It's only fair I tell you everything now.
say:8:1660007006:1.source_cn: 请进来喝点热汤、休息休息吧。你们信守了承诺，没有伤害他...

say:12:1660007007:0.text: Sitting by the warm hearth, Oxana begins to recount their story...
say:12:1660007007:0.source_cn: 温暖的炉火边，奥克萨娜向你们讲述了二人的过去……
say:12:1660007007:0.male: Sitting by the warm hearth, Oxana begins to recount their story...
say:12:1660007007:0.female: Sitting by the warm hearth, Oxana begins to recount their story...

say:13:1660007008:1.text: A mortal woman and an ageless Graveborn fell in love. They chose to live a quiet life in the hills. But as her body began to fail, Kiran grew desperate. Like a child clinging to a dream, he began searching for anything that could defy time.
say:13:1660007008:1.source_cn: 短寿的人类与不会衰老的亡灵相爱了，两人一起在偏僻的山中...

say:14:1660007009:0.text: Then one day, he came back beaming, holding a crystal in his hands. He said it had awakened the frostbloom—a plant from old legends said to bear fruit that could slow the march of death.
say:14:1660007009:0.source_cn: 直到有一天，他欣喜若狂地带回了那枚魔晶，告诉她，因为魔...

say:17:1660007010:1.text: At first, I let him go on. He looked so hopeful, so happy. But then I saw the wounds. Ones that never healed. That's when I realized what this "hope" was costing him.
say:17:1660007010:1.source_cn: 一开始的时候，看着他那么开心，我也就由着他了。直到我发...

say:18:1660007011:1.text: The snow, the Hypofiends... it all started with the crystal. I never wanted any of this, but by then, he was in too deep. I couldn't stop him, no matter how I tried...
say:18:1660007011:1.source_cn: 风雪引来了魔物，也给许多人带来了麻烦。我不想事情变成这...

say:19:1660007012:1.text: I thought I was ready to let go, to leave quietly. But even the shadow of my absence terrifies him more than death itself...
say:19:1660007012:1.source_cn: 我以为，我已经准备好平静地迎接告别了。可对他而言，没有...

say:20:1660007013:1.text: When Oxana finishes her story, the room falls into silence.
say:20:1660007013:1.source_cn: 奥克萨娜的讲述告一段落，小屋内陷入了沉默。

say:22:1660007014:1.text: ... To Kiran, nothing is more precious than the time he had with Oxana.
say:22:1660007014:1.source_cn: ……对他来说，与奥克萨娜共度的时光比任何事物都珍贵啊。

say:23:1660007015:1.text: I just hope the sky clears soon. When it does... maybe he'll come home.
say:23:1660007015:1.source_cn: ……我只希望，天空能快点放晴。天晴的那一天……基里尔就...

say:25:1660007016:1.text: It's getting late. You decide to stay the night. Oxana lights a small oil lamp before going to bed.
say:25:1660007016:1.source_cn: 天色已晚，你们决定在小屋暂住。临睡前，奥克萨娜点亮了油灯。
say:25:1660007016:1.male: It's getting late. You decide to stay the night. Oxana lights a small oil lamp before going to bed.
say:25:1660007016:1.female: It's getting late. You decide to stay the night. Oxana lights a small oil lamp before going to bed.

say:26:1660007017:1.text: Go on and get some rest. I... I've got a bit of sewing to do.
say:26:1660007017:1.source_cn: 你们先睡吧，我……还有一件衣服要缝。

say:29:1660007018:1.text: The night deepens. Oxana and Frieren are fast asleep, but you and Himmel remain by the fire.
say:29:1660007018:1.source_cn: 夜色渐深，奥克萨娜和芙莉莲已经睡下，你和辛美尔还围坐在...
say:29:1660007018:1.male: The night deepens. Oxana and Frieren are fast asleep, but you and Himmel remain by the fire.
say:29:1660007018:1.female: The night deepens. Oxana and Frieren are fast asleep, but you and Himmel remain by the fire.

say:31:1660007019:1.text: We can't just sit around and hope the problem solves itself...
say:31:1660007019:1.source_cn: 这样等下去，恐怕无法解决问题……

say:31:1660007019:1.female: We can't just sit around and hope the problem solves itself...
